units.pressure_mu_0_to_4: d^n P / d mu_q^n, n=0:4, fm^(n-4)
units.chemical: same as pressure_mu_0_to_4; fixed mean fields
units.thermal: [dP/dT, d2P/dT2], fixed mean fields, fm^-3 and fm^-2
